content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Billboard advertising, broadband and insurance operations; no debt purchasing or collection business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced insurance claims adjusting for insurers and employers, not buying and collecting consumer debt."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Pawn lending and used merchandise retail; it lends against collateral rather than buying and collecting debt."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Franchised insurance agency placing personal and commercial policies for commissions; different business entirely."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Consumer international money remittances for a transfer fee; no debt ownership or collection."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"AI lending platform connecting lenders and investors to originate and fund new loans, not collecting charged-off debt."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Buys charged-off consumer debt portfolios from banks and collects from consumers, the same business model as the target."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Lease-to-own payment plans for retail goods; it funds merchandise purchases rather than purchasing and collecting charged-off debt."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Commercial and personal insurance brokerage earning carrier commissions; no debt portfolio purchase or collection."}]}
